name: ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1
summary: The ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) smartphone from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX, IECEx and UKEX, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 15, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: cMETus (Eurofins MET, E115956): Class I Div 1 Groups A-D T4; Class II Div 1 E-G T4; Class III Div 1; Class I Zone 1 AEx ia IIC T4 Gb; Zone 21 AEx ia IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: Charging, SIM-card and battery-pack replacement only in non-hazardous areas; charge only at 0 to 45 °C; battery cover must be fitted before entering the hazardous area (IECEx EPS 23.0021X).

specs.camera: 13 MP PDAF, LED flash (optimised for scanning)
specs.keys: Programmable PTT, alarm (LWP) and multifunction keys; fingerprint in power key
specs.accessories: USB-C; docking charge pads; 3.5 mm audio with PTT accessory support

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (eSentinel alarm app, assignable to the alarm key)

variants.name: Smart-Ex 03 DZ1M
variants.description: Mining version, certified for Group I (underground mining) only. It has no gas or dust zone rating.

strengths: ATEX, IECEx and UKEX certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
A mining version (Group I) is also available
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
